Na etapie zagospodarowania terenu, gdy g: During landscaping, once access routes and substrate are ready. Paint and surfaces are applied to dry substrates above freezing, usually from spring to autumn.

Na realizację daję 12 miesięcy gwarancji: I provide a 12-month warranty on delivery and ongoing surface support. After years of use, the paint can be refreshed without replacing the structure.
